record.question: When did the car explosion near the Red Fort which killed at least 15 people occur?
record.explanation: Answer A: 10th November, 2025. The Union Cabinet’s 12 November 2025 resolution records that the car explosion near the Red Fort occurred on the evening of 10 November 2025; the answer is 10 November. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2189384&lang=1&reg=3. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
